clips.text: You may still state your boundaries before the tower. Rescue will not be withdrawn for your answer.
First release the binding, dream validation, and blood oath; then confirm voluntary participation separately.
The seals establish provenance. They grant no authority over you.
It is stored outside the boundary and carried back by custodians. Time does not reverse everywhere.
Three-way synchronization is essential. We can reorder checks, not transfer a cost in lives.
Ending them may cost power or some memories. Consent cannot be signed by someone else.
There is no sacrificial clause here.
This is the clock’s historical charter, not proof of a previous incarnation.
We record only the agreements you want now. They may still change later.
We can verify gaps with independent records, not someone’s confidence in their memory.
Independent records matched with personal names form a memory anchor.
Love cannot sign for you. Neither can memory.
We verified it on day three: names matched with independent records can form an alternative anchor.
Both have teams. The backup generator can reach only one first.
Revocation belongs to the current operator. An old promise cannot sign for them.
You may inspect the records before stating your terms.
I would rather repeat the city than lose control of it.
Keep the loop, and you can keep those memories.
If you take copies, leave a complete handover record.
The original records are in the red archive. Access must be registered.
After shutdown, I cannot guarantee everyone will keep obeying.
Without a keeper, what will tomorrow be?
After revocation, the city will no longer answer to me.
You can still stop.
On the seventh day, you will wear the crown as the hundredth bride.
You’re alive.
You do not need to remember those fragments to have the right to refuse me.
Remembering does not give me the right to decide for you.
I can feel the warmth of the sun.
The same seven days. I remember ninety-nine of them.
That relationship is not one you are required to continue now.
If you wish, we can begin again with a first date.
Immortality is not the same as living.
I can give you records. You need not take my word for it.
Your entry record is not consent to wear the crown.
Look at me. Stay with my voice.
His dreams may be affected by the clock. They are not testimony by themselves.
I can tell you the happier fragments, or we can discuss only evidence.
Two blocks were erased. The death still happened.
I died that time. The reset brought me back without taking the memory.
I have never heard this recording before.
That stamp needs checking. My dislike is not proof of guilt.
Strength did not keep me alive. It kept restarting me.
The seal comes from the council. The signature is not yet confirmed.
That was control, not protection. Fear does not excuse it.
I love you now, not only the fragments I remember.
In cycle fifty-four, I locked you inside, thinking it would keep you from the rooftop.
I consent to release my binding.
This is the first time you have brought back a fragment of dying.
We release control of time, not anyone’s life.
No one died for this restoration. Preserve the procedure.
Before, I would have taken it away myself. Not this time.
We were close then. Later, you asked me not to decide for you.
You may care, or we can discuss only how to end the binding.
I joined later. I had never seen this original addendum.
Before midnight on Friday, do not go to that rooftop alone.
I remember the midnight bell and her breath stopping in my arms.
Not ninety-nine centuries. Ninety-nine weeks that could not end.
It releases fragments. Fragments are not the whole truth.
I need help. You are not obliged to bear the risk for me.
You decide who stays for the next step.
That is why I keep examination and custody records, not conclusions about dreams.
Your life is not powering this. The names are responding.
A future without a romantic decision is still complete.
Ana Morales. She still remembers that she loves astronomy.
All three channels are ready, with medical backup.
The people are still here. We need their records to stay, too.
The breach spread. I cannot call fear a medical judgment.
I confirm my own risk. It will not be transferred to someone else.
The invitation to the coast comes with no relationship conditions.
None of them remain in the electronic records.
The hospital needs continuous power. Manual ventilation can bridge a short gap.
I want a future. You do not owe me that future.
The risks need review, and medical support must be present.
This time, we listen to the people affected before deciding how to help.
The door can hold for six minutes. The stairs lead to the outdoor triage area.
Since the number ninety-seven began appearing, I keep dreaming of this place.
May I examine it? You can stop me at any point.
I dreamed of a heartbeat returning. The dream had no date.
Resource allocation is not a test of whom you love.
The exit is usable. The evidence pouch is on the desk; I have the stretcher.
I kept anomalous patients inside, believing a locked door would protect everyone else.
Rescue cannot wait. Neither can the witness procedure be skipped.
Your vital signs are stable. We will check again, not rely on one moment.
Even if you walk alone, I will still stand against that clock.
The blood oath cannot replace consent today.
You need not forgive me. Both versions are yours to examine.
My fragment contains a mask. I cannot prove who wore it.
I carried out an order without checking who would be harmed.
Rebuilding the hunters needs witnesses, not anyone belonging to anyone.
Do not let my injury make the decision for you.
Freedom is not something we award you for helping save the city.
I checked twice. The clock did not restart.
The south tunnel needs pumping. The dry north passage works, but takes longer.
We execute together after your plan is confirmed.
In cycle seventy-six, I carried out an order against you.
Missing memories do not excuse me. The original order is at headquarters.
Then we keep checking. We do not invent a name for a blank.
I sign for myself, not for anyone else.
No more orders of uncertain origin. If evidence is missing, we stop.
I acted without comparing the two versions.
先解除绑定、梦境校验和血誓，再分别确认自愿。
爱情不能代签，记忆也不能代签。
终止后可能失去力量或部分记忆。不能替本人签同意。
这是时钟装置的历史原约，不是你的前世证明。
这里没有任何献祭条款。
独立记录与本人姓名重合，形成了记忆锚。
三路同步是底线。可以改变校验先后，不能转移生命代价。
缺口能用独立记录核验，不能只靠谁记性好。
进塔前还可以谈边界。救援不会因为你的答案撤回。
第三日验证过：姓名与独立记录可以形成替代锚。
只记录你现在愿意留下的约定。以后仍可以改变。
两边都有队伍，备用电源只能先送一处。
印章只证明材料来源，不代表谁有权支配你。
它放在结界外，再由保管人带回。不是所有地方都倒流。
撤销权属于当前启用者，不由旧承诺代签。
撤销之后，城市不会再听我指挥。
停机后，我不能保证所有人继续服从。
第七日，你会以第一百位新娘的身份戴冠。
你们仍可以停下来。
你们要带走副本，就留下完整的交接记录。
原始记录在红色档案室，访问方式须登记。
保留循环，你可以继续拥有那些记忆。
你可以先看记录，再告诉我你的要求。
我宁可让城市重复，也不愿失去控制。
没有守护者，明天会怎样？
同样的七天，我记得九十九遍。
我不是靠强大活到现在，是被它不断重新启动。
他的梦可能受时钟影响，不能直接当证词。
封印出自议会。签名还不能确认。
这份录音，我以前没有听过。
我的绑定，我自己同意解除。
它会放出片段。片段不等于完整事实。
周五午夜前，别独自去那座天台。
这枚印章需要核验。不能因为我不喜欢他们，就认定他们有罪。
你还活着。
你不必记得那些片段，才有资格拒绝我。
我需要帮助，但你没有替我承担的义务。
那是控制，不是保护。我不能用害怕为它开脱。
这次恢复没有发生死亡。把过程留下。
两个街区被吞掉，死亡仍发生了。
我能提供记录。你不必只听我的话。
那次我死了。重置把我带回来，没有带走记忆。
这一次，你第一次带回了死亡的片段。
我爱的是现在的你，不只是我记得的那些片段。
我愿意讲快乐的片段，也愿意接受你只谈证据。
第五十四次，我把你锁在屋里，以为能避开天台。
不死，和真正活着，不是一回事。
以前我会自己拿走它。这次不。
如果你愿意，我们可以从第一次约会重新开始。
那段关系不是你现在必须继续的关系。
我后来才加入。我没有见过这份原始附页。
你的入场记录，不是同意戴冠的记录。
不是九十九个世纪，是九十九次没能结束的一周。
解除的是对时间的控制，不是谁的生命。
我记得午夜时钟响起，她在我怀里停止呼吸。
我能感觉到太阳的暖意。
那次我们曾亲近。你后来要求我不要替你决定。
你可以关心，也可以只谈怎么解除绑定。
看着我。跟着我的声音。
我记得，不等于我有权替你决定。
海边的邀请没有附带关系条件。
裂缝扩大了。我不能把恐惧写成医疗判断。
生命体征稳定。之后还会复查，不只看这一刻。
先后顺序由资源决定，不由你喜欢谁决定。
所以我保留检查和签收记录，不替梦下结论。
我的风险由我确认，不转给别人。
门还能撑六分钟。楼梯通向外面的临时诊区。
我梦见心跳恢复。梦里没有日期。
救援不能等。见证程序也不能省。
这次先听当事人的话，再决定怎么救。
不是你的命在供电。是这些名字在回应。
风险要复核，医疗支持也要到场。
出口还能走。证物袋在桌上，担架在我这里。
医院需要连续供电。人工通气可以短时接上。
我把异常患者留在医院，以为封门就能保护别人。
不决定恋爱，也是一份完整的未来。
接下来谁留下，由你决定。
可以检查吗？你随时可以叫停。
三路都准备好，医疗备用也在。
从九十七这个数字出现后，我就一直梦见这里。
人还在。我们先让记录也留下。
我想有未来。但你不欠我那个未来。
安娜·莫拉莱斯。她一直记得自己喜欢天文学。
电子病历里，一个都没有了。
我签自己的，不替别人签。
等你的方案确认，再同时执行。
我执行了命令，没有核对受伤的是谁。
我检查了两遍。时钟没有重启。
那就继续查，不替空白填名字。
我的片段里有假面。我无法证明是谁戴着它。
重建猎人团需要见证人，不需要谁成为谁的所有物。
南隧道要排水。北侧干通道也能绕行，但更慢。
你可以不原谅。两版记录都给你。
自由不是我们救城之后，才赏给你的东西。
我没有核对两版，就执行了。
记忆不完整不是免责。原始命令在团部。
不再执行来路不明的命令。证据不齐，就停。
血誓不能代替今天的同意。
别因为我受伤，就把判断交给我。
即使你独自走，我也会继续反对那座时钟。
第七十六次，我执行过针对你的命令。
